description: Intercepts outbound adapter API calls during the simulation phase and returns pre-recorded static mock responses from disk instead of making real network calls. Enables full end-to-end pipeline testing without requiring live API credentials or incurring API quota costs. Reads mock JSON files keyed by adapter name and version from the backend mock library. Used during Stage 7 (Simulation) to validate the integration config, hooks, and transformation rules in a safe, cost-free environment before live deployment.
use_cases: Simulating CIBIL bureau response without real PAN lookup
Testing integration pipeline end-to-end without API credentials
Validating config and transformation rules using mock data
Running regression tests against fixed mock responses
Cost-free pipeline validation before production go-live
when_to_use: Active only during simulation phase (Stage 7). Intercepts all adapter calls and returns mocks. Must be disabled or bypassed in production.
trigger_condition: Right before network call, only when pipeline is in simulation mode

input_parameters.description: Adapter whose call is being intercepted
Adapter version for mock file selection
Flag indicating simulation mode is active
Filesystem path to mock JSON directory

output.on_success: Mock response loaded and returned as if real; simulation_mode: true attached
output.on_failure: Mock file not found; adapter marked SIMULATION_FAILED in report

error_codes.HOOK_001: Mock payload file missing on disk.
